resources.string: Hesabu reads your money messages so you don\'t have to
A weekly and monthly account of where your money went, counted from the messages already on this phone.
Hesabu parses M-Pesa, Airtel Money, T-Kash and bank messages on this phone and keeps a ledger.
The messages never leave the phone. Only the counted figures do, if you turn reports on.
Every number can be opened to see the messages it was counted from.
Skip SMS access and import messages by sharing or pasting
Hesabu asks for SMS access to read money messages. Here is exactly what that means.
Only messages from these financial senders. Messages from anyone else are not read, and not read into memory beyond checking the sender.
Structured transactions: amount, fee, date, type and a masked counterparty. Never the message itself, and only if you turn sync on with your own server address.
Turn SMS access off any time in Android Settings, Apps, Hesabu, Permissions. Hesabu keeps working from messages you share or paste.
Without SMS access Hesabu cannot read messages as they arrive. You can share or paste messages into Hesabu instead.

Open Settings, Battery, More settings.\nAllow Hesabu to run in the background and to auto-launch.\nIn Settings, Apps, Hesabu, Battery usage, allow background activity.
Open i Manager, App manager, Autostart manager and allow Hesabu.\nIn Settings, Battery, Background power consumption management, allow Hesabu.
Open Settings, Battery, App launch.\nTurn off automatic management for Hesabu and allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Open Settings, Apps, Hesabu, Battery.\nChoose Unrestricted.\nIn Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, make sure Hesabu is not a sleeping app.
Open Settings, Apps, Hesabu, Battery.\nChoose Unrestricted or allow background activity.
